en.title: Rain that Sips the Night and the False Portrait
en.premise: Amidst a relentless downpour, a woman visits my office with a strange request: to find "another version of herself"—someone who should already be dead. According to official records, she is the only one who exists, yet the mystery of her mirror-image twin lingers. A cruel oath sworn twenty years ago on the "Hill of Promise" now bares its fangs, manifesting as a corpse in a locked room.

zh.title: 啜饮黑夜之雨与虚伪的肖像
zh.premise: 在倾盆大雨中，一名女子来到我的事务所，请求我帮她寻找那个本该已经死去的“另一个自己”。在户籍登记上本应仅存在一个人的她，以及那名镜像双胞胎之间隐藏的谜团。二十年前在“约定之丘”许下的残酷誓言，如今化作密室中的尸体，露出了狰狞的獠牙。
